meaning:
people, tribe, nation
Aramaic equivalent: um.mah (אֻמָּה "people" H0524)

elsewhere.note: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names, by their villages, and by their encampments: twelve princes, according to their nations.
The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.
Praise Yahweh, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!
